google_maps.label: Google Maps
google_maps.description: Powers the location / orbit map and city autocomplete (Maps JavaScript + Places). Supply your own referer-restricted key to use the map on your own custom domain; otherwise the platform key is used.

steps.s1: In Google Cloud Console, create (or pick) a project with billing enabled.
steps.s2: Enable the "Maps JavaScript API" and the "Places API" for that project.
steps.s3: Create an API key under APIs & Services → Credentials, then restrict it: Application restrictions → "HTTP referrers" → add your custom domain (e.g. https://your-domain.com/*).
steps.s4: Under API restrictions, limit the key to "Maps JavaScript API" and "Places API", then paste the key here.

ga4.label: Google Analytics 4
ga4.description: Track visits to your public site with Google Analytics 4. Paste your GA4 Measurement ID and the gtag.js snippet is injected on your storefront (consent-gated).

steps.s2: Under the Property column choose "Data streams", then select (or create) your Web stream.
steps.s3: Copy the "Measurement ID" at the top right of the stream details. It starts with "G-".
steps.s4: Paste the Measurement ID (e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX) here.

meta_pixel.label: Meta Pixel
meta_pixel.description: Measure conversions and build audiences for Facebook / Instagram ads. Paste your Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID and the base pixel code is injected on your storefront (consent-gated).

steps.s2: Select your pixel / dataset in the Data Sources list on the left.
steps.s3: Find the "Dataset ID" (Pixel ID) near the top. It is a long number.
steps.s4: Paste the numeric Pixel ID here.

tiktok_pixel.label: TikTok Pixel
tiktok_pixel.description: Track conversions from TikTok ads. Paste your TikTok Pixel ID and the pixel base code is injected on your storefront (consent-gated).

steps.s1: Open TikTok Ads Manager → Assets → Events.
steps.s2: Under "Web Events", open (or create) your pixel.
steps.s3: Copy the "Pixel ID" shown in the pixel's details, an alphanumeric code.

linkedin_insight.label: LinkedIn Insight Tag
linkedin_insight.description: Measure LinkedIn ad conversions and retarget visitors. Paste your LinkedIn Partner ID and the Insight Tag is injected on your storefront (consent-gated).

steps.s1: Open LinkedIn Campaign Manager → Analyze → Insight Tag.
steps.s2: Choose "Install my Insight Tag" / "Manage Insight Tag".
steps.s3: Copy your "Partner ID", a short numeric value.
steps.s4: Paste the numeric Partner ID here.

gtm.label: Google Tag Manager
gtm.description: Manage all your marketing tags from one container without editing the site. Paste your GTM Container ID and the container snippet is injected on your storefront (consent-gated).

steps.s2: Select your account and the container for this website.
steps.s3: Copy the Container ID shown near the top. It starts with "GTM-".
steps.s4: Paste the Container ID (e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX) here.

search_console.label: Google Search Console
search_console.description: Verify ownership of your storefront in Google Search Console to track how you rank in Search and submit your sitemap. Paste the verification token and the meta tag is added to your site's <head>.

steps.s1: Open Google Search Console (search.google.com/search-console) and add a property.
steps.s2: Choose the "URL prefix" property type and enter your exact storefront address (e.g. https://your-agency.tulala.digital, or your custom domain).
steps.s3: Pick the "HTML tag" verification method. Google shows a tag like <meta name="google-site-verification" content="TOKEN" />.
steps.s4: Copy ONLY the token — the value inside content="…" — paste it below and Save.
steps.s5: Back in Search Console, click Verify. Once verified, submit your sitemap at /sitemap.xml (e.g. https://your-agency.tulala.digital/sitemap.xml).

custom_code.label: Custom code
custom_code.description: Inject your own HTML / <script> into your public storefront: add a chat widget, a font, a verification meta tag, or any third-party snippet. Runs on your storefront only, never the admin.

steps.s1: Paste markup destined for the page <head> (meta tags, <link> stylesheets, analytics loaders) into the Head field.
steps.s2: Paste markup destined for the end of <body> (chat widgets, deferred <script> tags) into the Body field.
steps.s3: Only add code you trust. It runs on every page of your public storefront with full access to the page.
steps.s4: Save. Your storefront re-renders with the snippets injected; the admin and other tenants are never affected.

captcha.label: Captcha
captcha.description: Protect your storefront contact forms from spam with hCaptcha or Cloudflare Turnstile. Bring your own keys; the widget renders on your forms and submissions are verified server-side.

steps.s1: Pick a provider: hCaptcha (hcaptcha.com) or Cloudflare Turnstile (dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile).
steps.s2: Create a site for your storefront domain and copy the Site key (public) and Secret key (private).

social.youtubeConsent: You will approve read-only channel access with Google. Tulala stores encrypted tokens and marks channel ownership as verified.
social.oauthComingSoon: One-click OAuth is the next provider-specific step. This consent and storage foundation is ready for it.
